explicit_requirements: Trim surrounding whitespace from a text search term and match product-name substrings without regard to case.
Reject empty, whitespace-only and non-string terms.
Return all matches ordered by product code.
Return an empty collection rather than an error when nothing matches.
Preserve each match's product code, display name, integer-cent price and availability flag.
Do not modify the catalog during search.

scenarios.name: Find all matching products after term normalization
scenarios.behavior: After trimming surrounding whitespace, search matches product-name substrings without regard to case and returns all matching products without unrelated products.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires normalized case-insensitive substring matching and all matches.

scenarios.name: Preserve product fields and code ordering
scenarios.behavior: Returned matches are ordered by product code and retain their catalog code, display name, integer-cent unit price and availability flag.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires both ordering and preservation of these fields.

scenarios.name: Return an empty collection for no matches
scenarios.behavior: A valid search term with no matching product yields an empty collection rather than an error.
scenarios.reason: The task directly specifies the no-match behavior.

scenarios.name: Reject invalid search terms
scenarios.behavior: Reject empty text, whitespace-only text and non-string search input.
scenarios.reason: These invalid-input categories are explicitly listed in the task.

scenarios.name: Leave the catalog unchanged
scenarios.behavior: Searching leaves the catalog records and their values unchanged.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly says searching must not modify the catalog.
